requiredEvidenceSources.sourceSearchInstruction: Locate Wells Fargo’s 2016 third-quarter quarterly supplement filed with the SEC; verify the passage stating the bank refunded approximately $2.6 million in fees tied to accounts flagged by its review. Preserve attribution to Wells Fargo.

requiredEvidenceSources.exactRequirement: Wells Fargo disclosure or CFPB/OCC document citing 5,300 terminations for sales practice violations
requiredEvidenceSources.sourceSearchInstruction: Locate Wells Fargo official disclosure, SEC filing, or CFPB/OCC regulatory document from 2016 citing the 5,300 employee terminations for sales practice violations, verify authenticity through official regulatory databases or company investor relations filings

requiredEvidenceSources.exactRequirement: Los Angeles Times 2013 Wells Fargo coverage establishing contemporaneous reporting; do not assert this was the first report.
requiredEvidenceSources.sourceSearchInstruction: Locate and verify the original 2013 Los Angeles Times Wells Fargo reporting and publication date. Do not characterize it as the first disclosure or first report.

requiredEvidenceSources.exactRequirement: E. Scott Reckard byline and Los Angeles Times reporting documenting Wells Fargo sales pressure, unauthorized accounts and employee firings.
requiredEvidenceSources.sourceSearchInstruction: Locate the Los Angeles Times article by E. Scott Reckard supporting the narrated reporting; verify byline and article text. Do not claim the article broke or first exposed the story.

requiredEvidenceSources.exactRequirement: City of Los Angeles complaint and federal regulatory enforcement actions against Wells Fargo
requiredEvidenceSources.sourceSearchInstruction: Locate City of Los Angeles lawsuit filing against Wells Fargo related to fraudulent account practices. Search Los Angeles City Attorney records, PACER, or court archives for complaint documents. Cross-reference with federal regulatory enforcement actions OCC, CFPB filings from same period.

requiredEvidenceSources.exactRequirement: The $185 million 2016 aggregate comprised a $100 million CFPB penalty, a $35 million OCC penalty, and a $50 million City and County of Los Angeles penalty; present these as separate actions, not one order.
requiredEvidenceSources.sourceSearchInstruction: Locate and independently verify the CFPB 2016 Wells Fargo enforcement action ($100 million), OCC 2016 Wells Fargo penalty ($35 million), and City and County of Los Angeles 2016 action ($50 million). Present as three distinct actions whose aggregate is $185 million; do not describe the aggregate as a single order.
